documents.name: journal-entries
documents.summary: Journal entries, and the journal entry of every transaction
documents.label: number

filters.help: only entries with this status: draft, posted or void
only the entries of this transaction type (journal is an entry made by hand)

documents.deleteHelp: Only a draft can be deleted. Void a posted journal entry with `void`: it stays in the books with its number, and its amounts no longer count.

fields.name: date
fields.help: the date of the entry, as YYYY-MM-DD

fields.name: memo
fields.help: a note for the whole entry

fields.name: auto_reverse_on
fields.help: a date, as YYYY-MM-DD: Books posts the reversing entry on that day

fields.name: status
fields.help: draft, posted or void; `add --post`, `post` and `void` change it

fields.name: doc_type
fields.help: the transaction type the entry belongs to; journal for an entry made by hand

fields.name: origin
fields.help: how the entry came to be; document for the entry Books writes for a transaction

fields.name: document
fields.help: the id of the transaction Books wrote the entry for

fields.name: number
fields.help: the entry number; Books gives it when the entry is posted

fields.name: total
fields.help: the sum of the debits, in cents; Books computes it

fields.name: revision
fields.help: the count of saves; the commands send it so two callers cannot overwrite each other

fields.name: currency
fields.help: the currency of the books

fields.name: reverses
fields.help: the entry this one reverses

fields.name: replaces
fields.help: the posted entry this one corrects; `edit` of a posted entry sets it

fields.name: account
fields.help: the account of the line

fields.name: debit
fields.help: the debit, in cents; a line has a debit or a credit

fields.name: credit
fields.help: the credit, in cents; a line has a debit or a credit

fields.name: memo
fields.help: a note for the line

fields.name: customer
fields.help: the customer of a line on an accounts receivable account

fields.name: vendor
fields.help: the vendor of a line on an accounts payable account

documents.name: invoices
documents.summary: Invoices: what a customer owes for a sale
documents.label: number

filters.help: only invoices with this status: draft, posted or void
only the invoices of the customer with this id

documents.deleteHelp: Only a draft can be deleted. Void a posted invoice with `void`: it stays in the books with its number, and its amounts no longer count.

fields.name: customer
fields.help: the customer who owes the invoice

fields.name: date
fields.help: the invoice date, as YYYY-MM-DD

fields.name: due_date
fields.help: the day the invoice is due, as YYYY-MM-DD

fields.name: terms
fields.help: the payment terms printed on the invoice; Books does not compute due_date from them

fields.name: bill_to
fields.help: the billing address printed on the invoice

fields.name: email
fields.help: the address the invoice is sent to

fields.name: tax_rate
fields.help: the sales tax rate or group for the taxable lines

fields.name: message
fields.help: a message to the customer, printed on the invoice

fields.name: memo
fields.help: a note for the books; the customer does not see it

fields.name: status
fields.help: draft, posted or void; `add --post`, `post` and `void` change it

fields.name: number
fields.help: the invoice number; Books gives it when the invoice is posted

fields.name: subtotal
fields.help: the sum of the lines before tax, in cents; Books computes it

fields.name: tax_total
fields.help: the sales tax, in cents; Books computes it

fields.name: total
fields.help: subtotal plus tax, in cents; Books computes it

fields.name: balance
fields.help: what the customer still owes, in cents

fields.name: written_off
fields.help: the part of the invoice written off as bad debt, in cents

fields.name: revision
fields.help: the count of saves; the commands send it so two callers cannot overwrite each other

fields.name: currency
fields.help: the currency of the books

fields.name: entry
fields.help: the journal entry Books wrote when the invoice was posted; `entry` prints it

fields.name: replaces
fields.help: the posted invoice this one corrects; `edit` of a posted invoice sets it

fields.name: replaced_by
fields.help: the invoice that corrects this one

fields.name: kind
fields.help: item: a product or service with a quantity and a rate; description: text only; subtotal: the sum of the lines above it; percent: a percentage of the item or subtotal right above it

fields.name: product
fields.help: the product or service of an item or percent line; an Inventory item moves stock when the document is posted

fields.name: description
fields.help: the text of the line

fields.name: quantity
fields.help: the quantity of an item line, with at most 2 decimals

fields.name: rate
fields.help: the price of one unit of an item line, in cents

fields.name: percent_ppm
fields.help: the percentage of a percent line, in parts per million; -100000 is a 10% discount

fields.name: taxable
fields.help: true when the header's tax rate applies to the line

fields.name: amount
fields.help: the amount of the line, in cents; Books computes it

fields.name: rate
fields.help: the tax rate or group of the document

fields.name: component
fields.help: the single rate this line is for; the rate itself when it is not a group

fields.name: agency
fields.help: the agency the tax is owed to

fields.name: rate_ppm
fields.help: the rate of the component, in parts per million

fields.name: gross_amount
fields.help: the subtotal of the document, in cents

fields.name: taxable_amount
fields.help: the sum of the taxable lines, in cents

fields.name: amount
fields.help: the tax of this component, in cents
